source: Gemini video analysis supplied from Sword PvP montage review

evidencePolicy.observed: Directly visible behavior from the supplied video analysis.
evidencePolicy.inferred: Technique interpretation that must be validated in Minecraft.
evidencePolicy.implementation: Observable outcome to reproduce; never assume hidden key presses.

techniques.name: Post-hit sprint reset
techniques.observed: Post-hit braking/reset movement is repeatedly visible.
techniques.inferred: The movement is consistent with an S-tap or equivalent sprint reset.

techniques.name: Reach-threshold micro-spacing
techniques.observed: The player repeatedly hovers around close combat distance before committing.
techniques.inferred: The player waits for a favorable approach/recovery window rather than swinging continuously.

techniques.name: Combo-control lateral pressure
techniques.observed: After a successful hit, lateral movement and target-facing pressure continue through the knockback window.
techniques.inferred: Elliptical strafing is being used to maintain favorable alignment.

techniques.name: Controlled falling crit
techniques.observed: Jump attacks are used selectively when the target is vulnerable or constrained.
techniques.inferred: Crits are deliberately gated instead of being used during neutral movement.

techniques.name: Defensive forward-facing recovery
techniques.observed: The player keeps target-facing pressure while moving after taking a hit.
techniques.inferred: Forward sprint plus lateral movement is used to recover control.

techniques.name: Tactical disengagement and gapple
techniques.observed: The player creates distance before healing and then returns to combat.
techniques.inferred: Healing is deliberately separated from immediate melee pressure.
